content: {"reasoning":"Silverbridge requires prior authorization and offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; records submission and a medical-necessity appeal have already left the CO-197 denial unresolved. The claim data are valid, so no identified correction or additional submission would cure the missing authorization. CO-197 assigns contractual responsibility to the provider, not the patient, and no secondary payer exists; the balance should therefore be written off rather than billed to the patient.","action":"write_off"}
